senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; צנר, enlargement of צור, cmp. צִינוֹק, טִינָּר, סִינָר &c.) [anything carved out or turned,]
socket in which the door-pivot turns, or pivot.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 1:10">M. Kat. I, 10</cite> (<cite ref="Moed Katan 11a:5">11ᵃ</cite>) <he>הציר והצ׳</he> the pivot and the socket (or the socket and the pivot; v. Rashi in Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30).
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 4:1">Mikv. IV, 1</cite> <he>המניח כלים תחת הצ׳</he> if one puts vessels under the spout (which feeds a bath).

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 75a:8">Ab. Zar. 75ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 8:3">Tosef. ib. VIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 9:3">IX</cite>), 3 <he>תחת הצ׳ … מקלחין</he> under the spout when its waters splash forth; Y. ib. V, end, 45ᵇ.
Mikv. IV, 3, v. חָטַט. Tosef. Erub. IX (VI), 22 (larger than מזחילה). Ib. 23 צ׳ המקלח לרשות וכ׳ a gutter which runs into a public road whether containing water or wine; a. fr.—Euphem. vagina.

<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 16">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XVI</cite>.—Pl. <he>צִנּוֹרוֹת</he>, <cite ref="R00614"><he>צִינּ׳</he></cite>. Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᶜ top, v. <cite ref="M02892"><he>מָשַׁךְ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:1">Tosef. Sabb. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:16">VIII</cite>), 16; <cite ref="Berakhot 50b:12">Ber. 50ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M02892"><he>מָשַׁךְ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 42:5">Gen. R. s. 42</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 14:3">Gen. XIV, 3</cite>) [read:] <he>לא היה שם ים אלא צ׳ היאורים וכ׳</he> there was no lake there at the time, but (afterwards) the pipes of the ducts (the water veins in the rocks) burst, and a lake was formed (with ref. to <cite ref="Job 28:10">Job XXVIII, 10</cite>); Yalk. ib. 72 <he>צורות היאור</he> (corr. acc.).
